rca of the issue: 'New Amenitie' button label — likely generated by a utility that strips a trailing 's' from the tab/entity name ('Amenities' → 'Amenitie'), rather than mapping tab→singular via a lookup. Fix: add explicit singular mapping (Amenities→Amenity, Spec Categories→Spec Category, Document Types→Document Type, Floor Plans→Floor Plan, Payment Modes→Payment Mode, Bank Accounts→Bank Account, Charge Types→Charge Type, …) in the component that renders master-new-btn. Low-risk, non-blocking.
